title: Better Link Party Claim

body:
# BetterLinkPartyClaim (BLPC)

**BetterLinkPartyClaim (BLPC)** is a Minecraft 1.12.2 Forge mod that combines chunk claiming with a server-authoritative party system, with optional BetterQuesting integration.

## Core Features

**Chunk Claiming**
- Full-screen chunk map (`M` key) with async terrain rendering and party color overlays
- Client-side minimap HUD (`N` key to toggle)
- Drag selection for bulk claim/unclaim/force-load
- One-click "unclaim all" / "unload all" buttons

**Party System**
- Three roles: `OWNER`, `ADMIN` (Moderator), `MEMBER`
- Five trust levels per protected action (`NONE` → `ALLY` → `MEMBER` → `MODERATOR` → `OWNER`)
- Per-action protection: block edit, block interact, attack entity, item use
- Separate trust level for fake-player automation mods (BuildCraft, EnderIO, etc.)
- Party-vs-party allies and enemies (replaces per-player allowlists)
- Free-to-join toggle, member cap, party color, description, explosion protection

**UI**
- Tabbed ModularUI party manager: Party Info / Protection / Allies / Enemies / Members / Invitations
- Searchable player and party rows with action tooltips
- Toast notifications for party events and claim-limit failures
- Transit notifications when members return home, allies visit, or enemies enter/leave

**BetterQuesting Integration** (optional)
- Per-player opt-in switch links a BLPC party to a BQu party
- Non-linked players never modify BQu state

**Chat Commands** (`/blpc` tree)
- Public: `list`, `info <party>`, `me`, `here`, `claims`, `invites`, `accept`, `decline`, `leave`
- OP-only under `/blpc admin`: `move-owner`, `kick`, `disband`
- Full tab completion for parties, members, and pending invitations

**Localization**: English (`en_us`) and Japanese (`ja_jp`).

**Persistence**: Party data, BQu link state, and chunk claims are stored under `world/betterlink/pc/` with one-time migration from the legacy pre-FTB-Lib layout.

## Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.12.2, Forge
- Required: ModularUI 3.1.5+
- Optional: BetterQuesting, JourneyMap
